title: Echos of the dark
description: a mod that improves the deep dark and he ussefullness
body:
ATETION MOD IS BEING REDONE AS "trails of the past"

This mod adds 2 itens a new potion

-sculk vial: can store up to 30 xp by right click [crafted with 3 echo shards and 2 amethyst]
-echo barrel: can store more itens than a normal barrel [crafted with 6 echo shards 2 sculk shikers and 1 barrel]
-haste: can now create potions of haste with echo shards
